uniform vec3 uSunDirection;
uniform vec3 uSunColor;
uniform vec3 uZenithColor;
uniform vec3 uHorizonColor;
uniform vec3 uGroundColor;
uniform float uFogDensity;
uniform float uFogHeightFalloff;
uniform float uFogStart;

vec3 atmosphereSky( vec3 dir ) {
  float up = max( dir.y, 0.0 );
  float t = pow( up, 0.52 );
  vec3 sky = mix( uHorizonColor, uZenithColor, t );
  float mu = max( dot( dir, uSunDirection ), 0.0 );
  float horizonBoost = 1.0 + 1.5 * ( 1.0 - t );
  sky += uSunColor * ( 0.035 * pow( mu, 3.0 ) * horizonBoost + 0.16 * pow( mu, 24.0 ) + 0.45 * pow( mu, 320.0 ) );
  sky = mix( sky, uGroundColor, ( 1.0 - smoothstep( -0.2, 0.0, dir.y ) ) );
  return sky;
}

vec3 atmosphereFogColor( vec3 viewDir ) {
  vec3 d = normalize( vec3( viewDir.x, max( viewDir.y, 0.0 ), viewDir.z ) + vec3( 0.0, 1e-4, 0.0 ) );
  return atmosphereSky( d );
}

float atmosphereFogAmount( vec3 worldPos ) {
  vec3 ray = worldPos - cameraPosition;
  float dist = length( ray );
  float d = max( dist - uFogStart, 0.0 );
  if ( d <= 0.0 ) return 0.0;
  float dirY = ray.y / max( dist, 1e-4 );
  float k = uFogHeightFalloff;
  float dy = dirY * d;
  float heightTerm = abs( k * dy ) > 1e-4 ? ( 1.0 - exp( -k * dy ) ) / ( k * dy ) : 1.0;
  float optical = uFogDensity * exp( -k * max( cameraPosition.y, 0.0 ) ) * d * heightTerm;
  return 1.0 - exp( -optical );
}

vec3 applyAtmosphere( vec3 color, vec3 worldPos, float scale ) {
  float fog = atmosphereFogAmount( worldPos ) * scale;
  if ( fog <= 0.0 ) return color;
  vec3 dir = normalize( worldPos - cameraPosition );
  return mix( color, atmosphereFogColor( dir ), fog );
}

var barghetoCoolerOwners76=new WeakMap;
function barghetoIndexCooler76(geometry){
 if(geometry.index||Object.keys(geometry.morphAttributes).length)return geometry;
 const names=Object.keys(geometry.attributes).sort(),attributes=names.map(name=>geometry.attributes[name]);
 if(!attributes.length||attributes.some(attribute=>attribute.isInterleavedBufferAttribute))return geometry;
 const count=attributes[0].count;
 if(attributes.some(attribute=>attribute.count!==count)||geometry.drawRange.start!==0||geometry.drawRange.count<count)return geometry;
 const words=attributes.map(attribute=>attribute.array instanceof Float32Array?new Uint32Array(attribute.array.buffer,attribute.array.byteOffset,attribute.array.length):attribute.array);
 const buckets=new Map(),representatives=[],links=[],indices=new Uint32Array(count);
 for(let vertex=0;vertex<count;vertex++){
  let hash=2166136261;
  for(let a=0;a<attributes.length;a++){const size=attributes[a].itemSize,data=words[a];for(let k=0;k<size;k++)hash=Math.imul(hash^data[vertex*size+k],16777619)}
  let match=-1;
  for(let candidate=buckets.get(hash)??-1;candidate!==-1;candidate=links[candidate]){
   const source=representatives[candidate];let equal=true;
   for(let a=0;a<attributes.length&&equal;a++){const size=attributes[a].itemSize,data=words[a];for(let k=0;k<size;k++)if(data[vertex*size+k]!==data[source*size+k]){equal=false;break}}
   if(equal){match=candidate;break}
  }
  if(match<0){match=representatives.length;representatives.push(vertex);links.push(buckets.get(hash)??-1);buckets.set(hash,match)}
  indices[vertex]=match;
 }
 if(representatives.length>=count*.95)return geometry;
 const indexed=geometry.clone();
 names.forEach((name,a)=>{const source=attributes[a],packed=new source.array.constructor(representatives.length*source.itemSize);for(let i=0;i<representatives.length;i++)for(let k=0;k<source.itemSize;k++)packed[i*source.itemSize+k]=source.array[representatives[i]*source.itemSize+k];const attribute=new source.constructor(packed,source.itemSize,source.normalized);attribute.name=source.name;attribute.gpuType=source.gpuType;attribute.setUsage(source.usage);indexed.setAttribute(name,attribute)});
 indexed.setIndex(Array.from(indices));indexed.computeBoundingBox();indexed.computeBoundingSphere();return indexed;
}
function barghetoOptimizeCooler76(root,owner,animatedNames){
 const groups=[],indexedCache=new WeakMap,belt=[],batches=[],empty=new Li;
 empty.setAttribute(`position`,new H([],3));empty.setDrawRange(0,0);
 const prepare=geometry=>{let result=indexedCache.get(geometry);if(!result){result=barghetoIndexCooler76(geometry);indexedCache.set(geometry,result)}return result};
 const indexStats={before:0,after:0},countVertices=mesh=>mesh.geometry.getAttribute(`position`)?.count??0;
 root.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);
 const candidates=[];root.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh instanceof U&&!mesh.isInstancedMesh){indexStats.before+=countVertices(mesh);candidates.push(mesh)}});
 for(const mesh of candidates){
  if(mesh.userData.airflow||mesh.name===`Sump_water_surface`||mesh.isSkinnedMesh||Array.isArray(mesh.material)||mesh.material.transparent||Object.keys(mesh.geometry.morphAttributes).length)continue;
  if(/^DRIVE_BELT_RIDGE_\d+$/.test(mesh.name)){belt.push(mesh);continue}
  let anchor=mesh.parent;while(anchor&&anchor!==root&&!animatedNames.has(anchor.name))anchor=anchor.parent;
  if(!anchor||anchor===root||animatedNames.has(mesh.name))continue;
  const signature=Object.keys(mesh.geometry.attributes).sort().map(name=>{const a=mesh.geometry.attributes[name];return [name,a.itemSize,a.normalized,a.array?.constructor.name,a.gpuType].join(`:`)}).join(`|`);
  let group=groups.find(group=>group.anchor===anchor&&group.material===mesh.material&&group.signature===signature&&group.castShadow===mesh.castShadow&&group.receiveShadow===mesh.receiveShadow&&group.renderOrder===mesh.renderOrder&&group.layers===mesh.layers.mask&&group.visible===mesh.visible);
  if(!group){group={anchor,material:mesh.material,signature,castShadow:mesh.castShadow,receiveShadow:mesh.receiveShadow,renderOrder:mesh.renderOrder,layers:mesh.layers.mask,visible:mesh.visible,meshes:[]};groups.push(group)}group.meshes.push(mesh);
 }
 let rigidSources=0,rigidBatches=0;
 for(const group of groups){
  if(group.meshes.length<2)continue;
  const inverse=group.anchor.matrixWorld.clone().invert(),geometries=[];
  let safe=true;
  for(const mesh of group.meshes){const transform=new z().multiplyMatrices(inverse,mesh.matrixWorld);if(transform.determinant()<=0||mesh.geometry.drawRange.start!==0||Number.isFinite(mesh.geometry.drawRange.count)){safe=false;break}const geometry=mesh.geometry.clone();geometry.applyMatrix4(transform);geometries.push(geometry)}
  if(!safe){for(const geometry of geometries)geometry.dispose();continue}
  // Normalize indexed state only, preserving every supplied vertex attribute.
  const hasIndex=geometries.every(geometry=>geometry.index!==null);
  for(let i=0;i<geometries.length;i++)if(!hasIndex&&geometries[i].index){const previous=geometries[i];geometries[i]=previous.toNonIndexed();previous.dispose()}
  const geometry=Pg(geometries,false);for(const temporary of geometries)temporary.dispose();if(!geometry)continue;
  const merged=new U(prepare(geometry),group.material);if(merged.geometry!==geometry)geometry.dispose();
  merged.name=`cooler-rigid-`+group.anchor.name+`-`+rigidBatches++;merged.castShadow=group.castShadow;merged.receiveShadow=group.receiveShadow;merged.renderOrder=group.renderOrder;merged.layers.mask=group.layers;merged.visible=group.visible;
  merged.userData={losslessCoolerBatch:true,sourceMeshes:group.meshes.map(mesh=>mesh.name)};
  group.anchor.add(merged);barghetoCoolerOwners76.set(merged,owner);
  for(const mesh of group.meshes)mesh.removeFromParent();rigidSources+=group.meshes.length;
 }
 const geometryEqual149=(a,b)=>{if(a===b)return true;if(a.drawRange.start!==b.drawRange.start||a.drawRange.count!==b.drawRange.count||a.groups.length||b.groups.length)return false;const keys=Object.keys(a.attributes);if(keys.length!==Object.keys(b.attributes).length)return false;const equal=(x,y)=>{if(!x||!y)return x===y;if(x.isInterleavedBufferAttribute||y.isInterleavedBufferAttribute||x.itemSize!==y.itemSize||x.normalized!==y.normalized||x.array.constructor!==y.array.constructor||x.array.length!==y.array.length)return false;for(let i=0;i<x.array.length;i++)if(x.array[i]!==y.array[i])return false;return true};return equal(a.index,b.index)&&keys.every(k=>equal(a.attributes[k],b.attributes[k]))};
 const beltGroups=[];
 for(const mesh of belt){let group=beltGroups.find(group=>geometryEqual149(group.geometry,mesh.geometry)&&group.material===mesh.material&&group.castShadow===mesh.castShadow&&group.receiveShadow===mesh.receiveShadow&&group.sources[0].renderOrder===mesh.renderOrder&&group.sources[0].layers.mask===mesh.layers.mask);if(!group){group={geometry:mesh.geometry,material:mesh.material,castShadow:mesh.castShadow,receiveShadow:mesh.receiveShadow,sources:[]};beltGroups.push(group)}group.sources.push(mesh)}
 for(const group of beltGroups){
  if(group.sources.length<2)continue;
  const batch=new eo(prepare(group.geometry),group.material,group.sources.length);batch.name=`cooler-belt-instances-`+batches.length;batch.castShadow=group.castShadow;batch.receiveShadow=group.receiveShadow;batch.renderOrder=group.sources[0].renderOrder;batch.layers.mask=group.sources[0].layers.mask;
  batch.userData={losslessCoolerBatch:true,sourceMeshes:group.sources.map(mesh=>mesh.name)};
  root.add(batch);barghetoCoolerOwners76.set(batch,owner);
  for(const source of group.sources){source.geometry=empty;source.isMesh=false;source.castShadow=false;source.receiveShadow=false;source.userData.coolerTransformOnly76=true}
  batches.push({batch,sources:group.sources,previous149:new Float64Array(group.sources.length*16).fill(NaN)});
 }
 root.traverse(mesh=>{if(!(mesh instanceof U)||mesh.geometry===empty||mesh.userData.airflow||mesh.name===`Sump_water_surface`)return;const original=mesh.geometry,indexed=prepare(original);mesh.geometry=indexed;if(indexed!==original&&mesh.name.startsWith(`cooler-static-`))original.dispose()});
 root.traverse(mesh=>{if(mesh instanceof U)indexStats.after+=countVertices(mesh)*(mesh.isInstancedMesh?mesh.count:1)});
 const inverse=new z,matrix=new z;
 const optimization={stats:{lossless:true,rigidSourceMeshes:rigidSources,rigidBatches,beltSources:batches.reduce((n,group)=>n+group.sources.length,0),beltBatches:batches.length,vertexReferencesBefore:indexStats.before,vertexReferencesAfter:indexStats.after},update(){
  if(!batches.length)return;root.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);inverse.copy(root.matrixWorld).invert();
  for(const group of batches){let dirty=false;for(let i=0;i<group.sources.length;i++){const source=group.sources[i];matrix.multiplyMatrices(inverse,source.matrixWorld);if(!source.visible)matrix.makeScale(0,0,0);let changed=false;for(let j=0;j<16;j++)if(group.previous149[i*16+j]!==matrix.elements[j]){changed=true;break}if(changed){group.previous149.set(matrix.elements,i*16);group.batch.setMatrixAt(i,matrix);dirty=true}}if(dirty){group.batch.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;group.batch.computeBoundingSphere()}}
 },dispose(){for(const {batch}of batches)batch.dispose();empty.dispose()}};
 optimization.update();return optimization;
}
